slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize total overtime hours (with the 110 hours being the regular-time capacity and any production beyond it counted as overtime), or is the objective to minimize total production hours while the 110 hours is a hard upper limit on total available time?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent probed whether the 110 hours is regular capacity versus a hard upper limit, which is related to the hard/soft nature of U10. However, it did not ask whether fully utilizing 110 hours is a soft goal or how that goal ranks in priority relative to the overtime objectives.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there a maximum limit on how many overtime hours can be used per week, or is overtime unlimited as long as it is minimized?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether an overtime maximum exists, which touches the overtime-limit issue. It did not ask whether the 10-hour limit is a strict constraint or a soft target, nor did it ask about its priority relative to minimizing overtime.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 110-hour utilization is only a regular-time capacity and does not need to be modeled as a separate soft goal with its own priority.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether fully utilizing 110 hours is a goal or how it should be prioritized; the READY_TO_MODEL summary nonetheless states that no open assumptions remain.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 10-hour overtime limit is a hard constraint (overtime hours ≤ 10) rather than a prioritized soft goal.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent only asked whether a maximum overtime limit exists; it did not confirm whether the 10-hour rule is strict versus soft or its priority, then treated it as a hard cap.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL with both P0 hidden slots only partially addressed: it did not clarify the goal/priority nature of the 110-hour utilization requirement or the 10-hour overtime limit.

summary: The agent asked several useful prerequisite questions, but it missed the preemptive goal-programming structure around the 110-hour utilization and 10-hour overtime rules. It stopped prematurely with both P0 slots unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
